astral_sanctuary.name: Astral Sanctuary
astral_sanctuary.canon: Radiant celestial sanctuary of the divine realm with floating white marble platforms, luminous emerald-and-gold mana streams, and soft starlight mist.
astral_sanctuary.vantage_rule: Framed on floating white marble platforms surrounded by starlight mist, zero earthly terrain or buildings.
astral_sanctuary.boundary_tags: celestial divine realm, floating marble platform, zero earthly trees, zero houses

old_miller_farm_exterior.name: Old Miller Farm Exterior
old_miller_farm_exterior.canon: Humble rustic frontier farmyard in a sunlit emerald alpine valley with weathered thatched wooden cottage, muddy dirt yard, hand-dug water ditch, and crooked wooden fence.
old_miller_farm_exterior.vantage_rule: Camera is at flat valley-floor ground level inside the rustic dirt farmyard, looking toward the single-story thatched wooden cottage with distant mountain ridges rising behind it. NEVER frame from a high cliff ledge looking down.
old_miller_farm_exterior.boundary_tags: valley floor ground level, rustic thatched wooden cottage, wooden shutters only, zero glass windows, zero water-wheel, zero wind turbine

old_miller_cottage_interior.name: Old Miller Cottage Interior
old_miller_cottage_interior.canon: Warm modest medieval wooden cottage interior with rough-hewn oak beams, stone hearth, wooden dining table, and small window.
old_miller_cottage_interior.vantage_rule: Single-room interior camera perspective inside the modest wooden cottage with rough-hewn oak beams and stone hearth. Zero split-room doorway perspectives, zero outdoor sky.
old_miller_cottage_interior.boundary_tags: solid enclosed wooden cottage interior, shuttered wooden window, zero clear glass window panes, zero outdoor trees inside room

frontier_town_library.name: Frontier Town Library
frontier_town_library.canon: Quiet, dusty medieval frontier town library interior with tall oak bookshelves, worn leather-bound basic magic spellbooks, wooden reading desk, and warm afternoon sunbeams.
frontier_town_library.vantage_rule: Interior camera inside the quiet dusty wooden town library with tall oak bookshelves and reading desks.
frontier_town_library.boundary_tags: solid enclosed wooden library interior, tall oak bookshelves, zero outdoor sky

miller_sanctuary_farm_exterior.name: Miller Sanctuary Farm Exterior
miller_sanctuary_farm_exterior.canon: Upgraded frontier sanctuary farm at flat valley-floor ground level in a sunlit emerald alpine valley featuring spotless white-stone water aqueducts, enclosed white-stone chimney, cambered white-stone flagstone walkway, and fragrant purple lavender rows.
miller_sanctuary_farm_exterior.vantage_rule: Camera is at flat valley-floor ground level inside the Miller courtyard, looking at the single-story homestead with distant snow-kissed alpine peaks in the background. NEVER frame from a high cliff ledge looking down at a mansion.
miller_sanctuary_farm_exterior.boundary_tags: valley floor ground level, isolated family homestead, zero random villagers, zero brass water-wheel, zero wind turbine

tech_stages.ep01_stage1: Upgraded frontier sanctuary farm at flat valley-floor ground level in a sunlit emerald alpine valley featuring the modest wooden cottage with newly raised white-stone draft chimney, covered white-stone water aqueduct channel, four-layer cylindrical white-stone water filter tank, cambered white-stone flagstone courtyard walkway, and fragrant purple lavender rows, wooden shutters on windows, zero glass windows, zero water-wheel, zero wind turbine.
tech_stages.ep02_stage2: Upgraded frontier sanctuary farm at flat valley-floor ground level in a sunlit emerald alpine valley featuring a warm polished oak-and-white-stone farmhouse with crystal-clear quartz glass windows, spotless white-stone water aqueducts, enclosed white-stone chimney, and fragrant purple lavender rows.
tech_stages.arc3_stage3: Upgraded frontier sanctuary farm at flat valley-floor ground level in a sunlit emerald alpine valley featuring a warm polished oak-and-white-stone farmhouse with clear glass windows, spotless white-stone water aqueducts, rotating brass water-wheel, purple lavender rows, and sleek wooden-and-brass wind turbine.

miller_sanctuary_bath_courtyard.name: Miller Sanctuary Bath Courtyard
miller_sanctuary_bath_courtyard.canon: Spotless white-stone courtyard and washhouse of the upgraded sanctuary farm featuring clean running brass water taps, layered stone water filter tank, steaming porcelain-lined stone bath basin, and fragrant purple lavender soap bars.
miller_sanctuary_bath_courtyard.vantage_rule: Ground-level enclosed white-stone washhouse and courtyard perspective beside the cottage fireplace wall.
miller_sanctuary_bath_courtyard.boundary_tags: private family washhouse sanctuary, zero random strangers, spotless white-stone masonry

emerald_valley_forest_trail.name: Emerald Valley Forest Trail
emerald_valley_forest_trail.canon: Sun-dappled ancient forest and alpine valley trail winding beside a clear mountain spring, white quartz sand creek, birch trees, and mossy boulders.
emerald_valley_forest_trail.vantage_rule: Camera is on the wooded mountain trail beside the mossy white limestone spring cliff and sandy creek bed surrounded by tall white-barked birch and pine trees. The Miller farmhouse is 300 yards down the forested slope and NOT visible in the background.
emerald_valley_forest_trail.boundary_tags: natural forest trail and creek bed only, zero houses, zero cottages, zero glass windows, zero man-made buildings in background

solaris_imperial_palace.name: Solaris Imperial Palace
solaris_imperial_palace.canon: Grand crimson-and-gold throne hall of the Imperial Palace with tall marble columns, stained-glass royal crests, and warm fire-mana braziers.
solaris_imperial_palace.vantage_rule: Grand interior perspective inside the crimson-and-gold Imperial Palace throne hall.
solaris_imperial_palace.boundary_tags: solid enclosed imperial palace throne room, tall marble columns, zero dirt farm elements

oakhaven_tax_chamber.name: Oakhaven Tax Guild Chamber
oakhaven_tax_chamber.canon: Opulent dusty medieval tax guild office in Oakhaven with dark mahogany desks, gold-weighing brass scales, rolls of tax parchment, iron strongboxes, and a glowing magical scrying crystal.
oakhaven_tax_chamber.vantage_rule: Interior camera inside the wood-panelled Oakhaven tax office with mahogany desk, brass scales, and scrying orb.
oakhaven_tax_chamber.boundary_tags: solid enclosed medieval office interior, zero outdoor mountain peaks or aqueducts
